title: Hidden-zone tools stay side-safe and replayable
steps: Runner starts Stack Search and receives a private select_cards Choice.
Invalid side and invalid option attempts are rejected.
Resolving Search moves the selected program to grip and shuffles the remaining stack through RandomDrawRecords.
Runner arranges the top 2 cards of the stack through a private ordered Choice.
Runner reveals a top stack card through a public reveal event.
Runner exposes an unrezzed installed Corp card without changing faceup or rezzed state.
Corp plays HQ R&D Swap Operation and swaps hidden HQ/R&D cards without public title leaks.
